hypotheses.rationale: The consistent early departures (05:00-05:30) combined with the hi-vis vest (Day 8) and laptop use (Day 2) strongly support a hybrid role requiring both site presence and remote admin work. The lack of contradictory evidence for other roles increases confidence.

Still plausible due to the hi-vis vest and early start, but the consistent laptop use at home and work badge suggest a managerial/administrative layer rather than pure trade labor. No new evidence contradicts this, but the hybrid office worker model better explains the full week's object distribution.
Removed. Consistent early morning departures and lack of late-night discriminative events continue to contradict this hypothesis.
